statement: Median Nvidia H100 on-demand rental is $3.85/hr on GPU clouds vs $7.43/hr on hyperscalers, with GPU prices up 24% from their November 2025 low.
why: Rental rates have recovered 24% off the November 2025 low with week-over-week volatility, a price overlay on GPU demand.

impact.mechanism: Rising rental prices can reflect tightening GPU-cloud availability but the price side does not score the index.

evidence.excerpt: GPU prices are up +24% from their November 2025 low
